title: Exception handling: one decision trace
teachingQuestion: What does exception handling require beyond completing a technical action?
focalInsight: Use the organization’s approval and risk-governance process; record compensating safeguards and an agreed review time or event.
caption: Follow the concept from meaning to the decision condition and its concrete failure consequence.

nodes.label: Exception handling
nodes.definition: Documenting and authorizing a deviation or residual-risk decision when the normal corrective path is not feasible.

nodes.decision: Use the organization’s approval and risk-governance process; record compensating safeguards and an agreed review time or event.
nodes.failureExample: A finding is marked accepted without an accountable owner or any condition for reconsideration.
